'''Mak Tennar '''was a commander within the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. He wrote a brief statement about the 501st Legion explaining its functions in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''. His printed statement also acted as one of the few official sources available about [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]].
